user.title: Room bindings
user.description: Choose a room measurement and its radiator valves. Optional target controls and programs are separate sources. Selecting entities never changes the source device settings or enables actuation.

data_description.temperature_entity: Select a separate room-temperature sensor (sensor entity), not the radiator valve, valve position or a target temperature. A TRV can measure differently near the radiator.
data_description.actuator_entities: Select the climate entities of the radiator valves (TRVs) serving this room. Multiple valves can share one room target. This selection does not by itself enable valve control.
data_description.schedule_entity: Optional: select an existing Home Assistant Schedule helper. Leave empty to use the local week editor or only the base target. A helper and a local week program cannot be active together.
data_description.setpoint_entity: Optional: select a wall thermostat or number/climate entity that supplies the desired room target. This is NOT the radiator valve/actuator and NOT a measured temperature. Leave empty for control from Home Assistant without an extra wall device.
data_description.base_temperature: Room target used in program gaps or when no program or temporary override applies. This field alone does not send a command to the TRV.
data_description.minimum_target_temperature: Lowest permitted room target, including program blocks; not a boiler-water limit.
data_description.maximum_target_temperature: Highest permitted room target, including program blocks; not a boiler-water limit.
data_description.maximum_age_ms: Maximum age of a qualified measurement; 120000 ms = 120 seconds. Not a polling interval. A cached HA state or last_reported alone is not proof of a fresh physical measurement.
data_description.program_action: Save bindings, edit local time blocks, or explicitly remove the local program. A Home Assistant Schedule helper is an alternative, not a second program source.

program.title: Room week program
program.description: Draft: {blocks} blocks; gaps use the base target {base} °C. Nothing is stored until Save. Select a single program source: local blocks OR a Schedule helper.

block.title: Time block
block.description: Local wall-clock interval [start, end). Split overnight blocks at midnight. Repeated autumn hours apply twice; nonexistent spring times are skipped.

edit_block.title: Choose a time block to edit

delete_block.title: Choose a time block to delete from draft

program_empty.title: No time blocks
program_empty.description: Continue to add a block or save an empty program using the base target.

program_save_error.title: Program cannot be exported
program_save_error.description: No changes were saved. Return to the draft and correct it, or cancel.

error.invalid_target_range: Choose a minimum below the maximum and a base temperature within these limits.
error.program_source_conflict: Choose one source. Clear the Schedule helper before editing local blocks; remove the local program before selecting a helper.
error.program_overlap: Time blocks overlap on a selected day.
error.program_limit: At most 28 day-blocks per week; selecting multiple days counts once per day.
error.invalid_program_time: Use whole-second times with start before end; split overnight blocks at midnight.
error.invalid_program: Choose valid days, times and a temperature within the room limits.
error.program_empty: There are no blocks to edit or delete.
error.program_export_failed: Cannot compile a bounded 15-day program: check timezone, room limits and maximum 128 transitions.

abort.shadow_mode_required: Select explicit v1 shadow mode first
abort.program_changed: The room was changed or removed while editing; reopen it.
abort.program_not_started: Open the week editor from room bindings first.

user.title: Central heating settings — draft only
user.description: Desired HA configuration only: NOT applied to E32. The existing shadow contract does not support this configuration yet. No source is qualified, no actuator is enabled and no heating command is sent. Room targets and week programs remain separate.

data.outdoor_source: Outdoor temperature source (optional when weather compensation is off)
data.fixed_fallback_temperature: Fixed fallback supply temperature (only for fixed fallback policy)

data_description.weather_enabled: Desired configuration draft only. The E32 remains the controller; saving does not enable weather control or change heating.
data_description.outdoor_source: Select an existing outdoor sensor or weather entity. A weather entity supplies its temperature attribute, not its condition text. Selection or an HA cache is not sample qualification.
data_description.outdoor_maximum_age_ms: Age limit for a qualified source observation, not a polling rate. Availability or last_reported alone is not a physical temperature sample.
data_description.stale_policy: Choose explicitly: block normal demand, or a configured fixed supply target within central bounds. No synthetic -20 °C outdoor fallback.
data_description.minimum_supply_temperature: Central water-temperature bound, not a room target. Proposed engineering bounds are not installation safety approval.
data_description.maximum_supply_temperature: Central water-temperature bound. Floor groups need their own mixing and independent physical temperature protection.
data_description.fixed_fallback_temperature: Leave empty when normal demand is blocked. For fixed fallback, select a target within the central supply bounds.
data_description.curve_0: Nine-point water curve using the existing E32 outdoor axis: +20, +15, +10, +5, 0, -5, -10, -15, -20 °C. Targets must not decrease towards colder weather. This draft is not executed.
